newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Decomposed bodies of four Bogota family members found.
newsitem.headline: Decomposed bodies of four Bogota family members found.

text.p: Police discovered the partially decomposed bodies of a family of four after neighbours complained of a putrid odour in a Bogota apartment building on Thursday.
A police spokesman said it appeared the man, a 42-year-old veteranarian, comitted suicide after shooting to death his wife, 39, also a veteranarian, and his two daughters ages 16 and 17.
It was not clear if the killings were the result of a suicide pact or if the man murdered his family before turning the gun on himself, the spokesman said.
"We went to investigate after neighbours complained of a nauseating smell coming from the family's apartment. It appears the bodies had been lying there for a week," the police spokesman said.
